title: A night watchman: on duty, night eyes, patrols
note: SANDBOX (by design: broad and diverse profiles, each with traits). Traits 0 to 1; SightRange in metres (daylight, open ground, a running body), ConeDegrees the half-angle, NoticeSeconds, MakeOutSeconds, ConcludeSeconds (each step up the ladder), HoldSeconds and CoolDownSeconds (calming down) in seconds (the proposed values). Keeps the peace (Duty 0.9). At night he sees a running body 30 x 0.85 x 0.58 = 14.8 m off. "duel" is how one of this kind fights when it does (the duelling brain's numbers by the arena's names; the rest the brain's defaults), SANDBOX.
